description: The whole book-site application in one component
purpose: Root shell of a book site
name: App

purpose: Collapsible docs navigation sidebar — wraps DocsTree with toggle control
name: DocsSidebar

purpose: Collapsible directory node — icons toggle children; the name opens the folder's own index.md when it has one, otherwise toggles too
name: DocsTree.Dir

properties.description: Id of the folder's index.md, hidden from the children
properties.name: doc

properties.description: Expanded state — stored toggle, or forced by the current document's path
properties.name: open

purpose: Clickable file leaf — highlights when its id matches nav doc param
name: DocsTree.File

description: Walks `@bookIndex.nodes`, dispatching each entry to DocsTree.Dir or DocsTree.File by its `type`. Open state comes from `@bookIndex.openPath` and the persisted `@treeState`, so it needs a BookIndexTreeService mounted as Ref="bookIndex" above it.
purpose: Docs file-tree navigator — renders nested dir/file structure and updates nav doc param on selection
name: DocsTree

description: Drop into a docs page to turn a question set into a graded drill: it tracks mastered and failed questions, filters by topic and tag, and ends on a score screen.
purpose: Self-check quiz over a set of questions
name: Quiz

properties.description: Question set handed to the quiz service
properties.name: data

properties.description: Prefix for the quiz's stored progress key, so several quizzes keep separate state
properties.name: name

description: Docs-site override of the default MDCheckbox: instead of a read-only marker it shows the reader's own progress for this item and toggles it in DocsService when clicked.
purpose: Docs-site task checkbox backed by reading progress
name: MDCheckbox.Book

properties.description: Stable hash of the task item's text, used as the progress key
properties.name: key

properties.description: Optional icon shown before the heading of a level 2 or 3 section
properties.name: icon

description: Docs-site override of the default MDLink: a link with a host opens in a new tab and is badged as external, while a link without one is resolved inside the site through BookIndexTreeService instead of leaving the page.
purpose: Docs-site link that separates in-repo from external targets
name: MDLink.Book

properties.description: Link target as written in the document
properties.name: href

properties.description: Host parsed out of the target; empty for an in-repo link
properties.name: host

description: Docs-site override of the default MDSection: the H1 section carries expand-all and collapse-all controls, while H2 and H3 sections open and close through DocsService and collapse to a single button once the reader marks them as read.
purpose: Docs-site heading section with expand state and read progress
name: MDSection.Book

properties.description: Heading level this section was built from
properties.name: level

properties.description: Stable section key used for the opened and progress state in DocsService
properties.name: key

properties.description: Optional icon shown before the heading of a level 2 or 3 section
properties.name: icon

description: Fetches the jsDelivr package listing from indexUrl (narrowed to scope), through a page-session cache, and resolves documents and links against it for the open docId: which folders to keep open, which node a document id or a clicked link lands on. DocsTree and MDLink bind it by the literal name `bookIndex`, so it must be mounted as Ref="bookIndex".
purpose: Loads a book's site-tree index and navigates it
name: BookIndexTreeService

properties.description: jsDelivr package listing endpoint (?structure=tree); writing it reloads the tree — write-only
properties.name: indexUrl

properties.description: Id of the open document — the base for the open path and relative links
properties.name: docId

properties.description: Directory of the listing this instance serves, dropped from the node ids
properties.name: scope

description: Fetches the selected document through docUrl, via a page-session cache, so a document already read is shown again without a request. The site tree lives in BookIndexTreeService. Apps subclass it to add their own state; the books kit registers it as-is.
purpose: Loads the selected document of a markdown docs corpus
name: DocsService

properties.description: Document id to show; writing it loads that document — write-only
properties.name: doc

properties.description: URL template for one document, '*' substituted
properties.name: docUrl

description: Picks the next question by priority — failed first, then unanswered, then already correct, each group shuffled — and skips anything shown within the last hour unless nothing else is left. A question is answered once: the first pick is recorded and further taps ignored. Progress, failure counts, last-shown times and the active filters all persist, so the session survives a reload. The quiz is done only when every filtered question stands at ok.
purpose: Spaced-repetition quiz over a question set, with topic and tag filters
name: QuizService

properties.description: Questions as { id, topics, tags, answers: [{ id, isCorrect }] }
properties.name: quiz
